meta.source: banterbull.com landing site (banterbull-Frontend/landing) — index.html inline styles + new.css
meta.themes: Single light theme; the site ships no dark mode by design.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Brand orange. Primary buttons, links, highlights, focus rings, the live dot, chart lines.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state for accent surfaces (primary button, links).

tokens.name: yes
tokens.usage: Brand teal. YES / positive / success — form success text, YES buttons, upward price moves.

tokens.name: no
tokens.usage: Brand red. NO / negative / error — form error text, NO buttons.

tokens.name: no-bright
tokens.usage: Brighter red used only for a downward price change on market charts (.mc-chg.down).

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background; the base surface.

tokens.name: bg-1
tokens.usage: Raised surface: cards, steps grid, footer band, 'what we believe' section.

tokens.name: bg-2
tokens.usage: Hover surface on raised elements (e.g. a step tile on hover).

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: Primary text and all headings.

tokens.name: fg-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: body copy, nav links, sub-headlines.

tokens.name: fg-3
tokens.usage: Tertiary / muted text: captions, fine print, input placeholders, eyebrows.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders and section dividers.

tokens.name: line-2
tokens.usage: Stronger borders: inputs, ghost button, waitlist field, hover borders.

tokens.name: market-slate
tokens.usage: Market/board card component: primary text on the Polymarket-style card surface.

tokens.name: market-slate-2
tokens.usage: Market/board card component: secondary text and axis labels.

tokens.name: market-slate-3
tokens.usage: Market/board card component: captions and disclaimers.

tokens.name: market-hairline
tokens.usage: Market/board card component: card borders and the NO button outline.

tokens.name: market-grid
tokens.usage: Market/board card component: dashed chart gridlines.

tokens.name: s-48

tokens.name: s-56
